description: This file contains unit tests for the MigraDoc Document Object Model, specifically testing bullet list rendering and spacing using the Xunit testing framework. It creates sample documents with different bullet list styles, verifies line spacing consistency, and generates PDF files for visual inspection.

classes.name: Bullets
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for bullet list creation and layout in MigraDoc, including spacing consistency verification.

methods.name: Create_Bullets
methods.description: Creates a sample document with various bullet lists, renders it to PDF, saves, and displays it.

methods.name: BulletLineSpacingTest
methods.description: Verifies that lines within bullet lists have consistent vertical spacing, ignoring bullet descent.
